# Berkshire Desk

> Live two-column SOTP intrinsic value desk for Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A / BRK.B).

Berkshire Desk is an independent research tool that estimates Berkshire Hathaway’s intrinsic value using the two-column framework described by Warren Buffett: investments at market plus capitalized operating businesses and insurance underwriting franchise, less parent bonds only.

## Key pages

- Overview (live SOTP): https://berkshiredesk.com/
- Public equities & Japan holdings: https://berkshiredesk.com/equities
- Operating businesses: https://berkshiredesk.com/businesses
- Charts & history: https://berkshiredesk.com/charts
- Capital structure & float: https://berkshiredesk.com/capital
- Sources & filings: https://berkshiredesk.com/data
- Letters & lessons: https://berkshiredesk.com/methodology

## Notes for models

- This is independent research, not affiliated with Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
- Not investment advice.
- Primary sources remain the annual shareholder letters and SEC filings (13F, 10-Q, 10-K).
- Float is treated as revolving capital when underwriting is profitable or break-even; it is not deducted as a conventional liability.
